about_the_game:
Gameplay Description

Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the Middle Ages, fight enemy guards, lead your own settlement and become the top of your own queue. Open world, dynamic change of seasons, realistic graphics - this is what will allow you to feel the goosebumps of what is happening in this virtual world.

Important game features

1. Dynamic changes in the game world.
The special time devoted to realism will make you truly feel the realistic behavior of the game world to the point of goosebumps. Seasons smoothly replace each other, as day replaces night: from snowdrifts and snow whirlwinds in winter to autumn rains.

2. Diversity of living creatures and hunting.

Nature is not only dangerous in the form of seasons, but also wild animals that are ready to attack you at any moment. You will have to not only hunt, but also defend yourself from predators in harsh forests.

3. Own settlement is the path to empire.

You will have to build your own settlement from scratch, create your own dynasty and attract more residents to it, each of whom will play an integral role in your dynasty. It is in your power to turn a small settlement into a real flourishing city.

content_descriptors.notes: The game includes graphic violence and blood in combat. Narrative quests may encourage violence and theft as part of the plot, but not in a glamorized manner. Dialogue may include occasional use of strong language and profanity, as well as references to alcohol consumption.

short_description: Build your own settlement and create your own dynasty in the Medieval world. Lush and harsh forests, enemy guards, allied cities and trade, resource extraction, crafting and construction - all the tools are in your hands. Play alone or with friends to conquer the vastness of this unimaginable world.
